items.why: The fear gauge is jumping as the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all drop at the open ahead of a pivotal week for AI.
Chip stocks are sliding as Nvidia drama continues to unfold and the Nasdaq drops at the open.
Tech is falling into a pivotal week for AI, with warnings that the AI bubble will likely burst weighing on big names.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures are down about 1.9% and the S&P future is down about 1.1%, with oil slipping and the VIX up sharply.
summary: Stocks are sharply lower Monday morning, with the Nasdaq leading the slide as AI worries weigh on tech ahead of a pivotal week. The VIX is spiking as investors brace for Nvidia earnings and the Anthropic IPO.
